description: This file contains static functions and definitions related to generating XML test summaries, including functions for opening, writing, and closing XML tags, as well as initializing and shutting down the summary process.

methods.name: clar_summary_close_tag
methods.description: Closes an XML tag with indentation based on the 'indent' parameter.

methods.name: clar_summary_testsuites
methods.description: Starts the XML document with the <testsuites> tag.

methods.name: clar_summary_testsuite
methods.description: Creates a <testsuite> XML element with provided attributes.

methods.name: clar_summary_testcase
methods.description: Creates a <testcase> XML element with name, classname, and elapsed time.

methods.name: clar_summary_failure
methods.description: Creates a <failure> XML element with type, message, and description.

methods.name: clar_summary_init
methods.description: Initializes a clar_summary structure, opens the output file.

methods.name: clar_summary_shutdown
methods.description: Finalizes the summary, writes remaining XML tags, and frees resources.
